result.description: The observation result. Type determined by $type discriminator.

parameters.description: Additional name-value pairs (e.g. depth, height above ground)

resultTime.description: Time the result became available (if different from phenomenonTime)

derivedFrom.description: AT-URIs of source observations or datastreams from which this observation was derived (e.g. tidal residual derived from observed and predicted level datastreams)

resultQuality.description: Quality flag as a token reference

phenomenonTime.description: Time the phenomenon was observed (ISO 8601). Start of interval if phenomenonTimeEnd is present.

featureOfInterest.description: AT-URI of the feature being observed, if different from the Thing's location

phenomenonTimeEnd.description: End of observation interval (ISO 8601). If absent, the observation is an instant. Used for aggregates (daily means), processing windows (wave burst statistics), and accumulations (hourly rainfall).

main.description: A single act of observation. The result type is determined by the $type discriminator on the result object.

labels.description: Optional labels identifying each element (e.g. frequency bin edges in Hz, depth bin centres in m). Must be same length as values if present.

values.description: Ordered array of scaled integer values

arrayResult.description: Array of scaled integer values sharing the parent Datastream's resultScaleFactor. Used for wave spectra (energy at frequency bins), current profiles (speed at depth bins), and similar array-valued observations.

booleanResult.description: True/false observation. Used for threshold exceedances, detection flags, binary sensor states.

numericResult.description: Scaled integer result. Real value = value × 10^(−resultScaleFactor). The common case for continuous measurements.

value.description: Code or label from the vocabulary

vocabulary.description: URI of the code list or vocabulary (e.g. https://codes.wmo.int/306/4677 for WMO present weather codes)

categoryResult.description: Categorical observation from a controlled vocabulary. Used for weather codes, flood alert levels, land cover classes, sea state.

altMm.description: Altitude in mm above WGS84 ellipsoid

geoPointResult.description: Geographic position result for position-as-observation (e.g. GPS fix from a drifting buoy). Uses the same encoding as Thing.location.
